attchmntText: Gammon India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Akash Rodka as Company Secretary & Compliance Officer of the company w.e.f. November 23, 2026.
voiceSummary: Gammon India Limited appointed Mr. Akash Rodkar as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer with effect from 23 November 2026. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee recommended the appointment on 23 November 2026. The Board of Directors approved the appointment during its meeting on the same day. The meeting commenced at 02:15 P.M. and concluded at 02:40 P.M. Mr. Rodkar is a B. Com graduate and a Company Secretary with more than one year of post-qualification experience. This intimation is filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015. The appointment is effective immediately upon approval.
